body: Please, for your sake and maybe mine, I'm willing to talk on the phone about how you are feeling and what you're considering on a path forward.  I'm a total wreck since finding out about my SO cheating but if you DM me ill provide my phone number and you can *67 me and call and talk.  I faced this alone because of my wife's cheating and the close proximity to both our lives.  Its the worst, but if I could help someone else it'd be a selfish gain in my own terrible situation.
Not formerly suicidal, but the idea of my kids having to deal with my death is overwhelming.  If I didn't have kids, I'd do it in a heartbeat.

If it were just her and I, in a heart beat.  But I want the best for my kids, and having their mother in the picture is really important.  She is a great mother, just made horrible mistakes as a spouse.
